prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Quick Preset Pet vs Custom Photo Creation"]
1: ["Automatic Pet Restoration", "Signing into your account automatically retrieves your saved pets and desktop preferences.", "Safe Cloud Save Active"]
2: ["Estimated render time remaining: 2 minutes"]
3: ["Compare companion traits side by side"]
4: ["Your pet is active on your screen. Click the tray icon anytime to customize or hide."]
5: ["All existing pets sync automatically when you sign in."]
6: ["Use a well-lit photo with clear contrast to ensure smooth pet rendering."]
7: ["Desktop Tray & Shortcuts", "Control your pet directly from your system tray menu or use quick shortcuts to hide or summon them anytime.", "System tray icon controls pet visibility"]
8: ["Choose Your Setup Path", "Select your preferred pet creation path and meet your companion in under a minute.", "Continue"]
9: ["Unlocked: Founding Parent Adoption Badge"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions a membership status or free extra reward ('Founding Parent Adoption Badge').
